text_simplified: Children are a gift and blessing from Allah, and thanking the Bestower requires fulfilling their rights, caring for them well, and raising them with Islamic manners. Allah commands the believers to protect themselves and their families from the Fire. Ali ibn Abi Talib, may Allah be pleased with him, explained this by saying: "Teach them and discipline them." Through teaching and discipline upon obedience to Allah lies the safety and salvation of children.
